skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine the LCD of two unlike denominators and convert both fractions into equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fraction numerators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions sharing a common denominator to obtain the fractional part of the result.

skills.name: Normalize improper fraction part
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into standard mixed-number form by carrying the extra unit into the whole part.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: When the minuend's fraction is smaller than the subtrahend's, borrow one whole unit (as denominator/denominator) from the whole part and add it to the fraction before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Subtract whole-number parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the two quantities (mixed numbers or whole numbers) to obtain the whole part of the result.
